note: Generated by R/checks/73_catalogue.R --render. Do not hand-edit and do not copy these fields into another store; licence and citation are read through to metadata/cdh/.

datasets.title: Human population (WorldPop 2020)
datasets.description: WorldPop 2020 population rasters used as the human-exposure denominator.

datasets.title: Atlas admin boundaries (GAUL 2024)
datasets.description: Admin 0/1/2 boundaries for the Atlas, as analysis-ready parquet and as 0.05 degree rasterised zonal layers.
datasets.gaps: Disputed-territory duplicate rows are an open Atlas-wide convention question (CR-115), not a data defect here.

datasets.title: Cattle heat stress layers
datasets.description: Pre-computed cattle heat-stress surfaces used by the livestock heat work.

datasets.title: CPC Relative Oceanic Nino Index (RONI)
datasets.description: NOAA CPC relative ONI, the ENSO phase definition the KE-ENSO analysis uses.
datasets.gaps: Referenced by Atlas outputs but not inventoried, versioned or archived by this project - if the source moves, the citation breaks.

datasets.title: Crop value of production, constant international dollars
datasets.description: MapSPAM production shares x FAOStat gross production value, in constant 2015 international dollars.
datasets.gaps: Currency basis must stay aligned with the livestock counterpart - a past mismatch (nominal USD vs constant international dollars) produced a roughly 7x error in cattle exposure.

datasets.title: JRC / GloFAS return-period river flood hazard
datasets.description: Modelled inundation depth for seven return periods (10 to 500 years), cropped to the Kenya window. The MODELLED flood-prone baseline.
datasets.citation_title: JRC / GloFAS Return-Period River Flood Hazard (Global)

datasets.title: MODIS NDVI (MOD13Q1)
datasets.description: Vegetation condition from MODIS MOD13Q1 v061, seasonal means, for the KE-ENSO vegetation layer.
datasets.citation_title: MODIS NDVI Seasonal Vegetation Condition (East Africa)
datasets.gaps: Requires NASA Earthdata credentials, so a new host cannot regenerate it unattended.

datasets.title: WRSI water requirement satisfaction index (FEWS NET)
datasets.description: Cropland and rangeland water requirement satisfaction index from USGS/FEWS NET, for the KE-ENSO agriculture layer.
datasets.citation_title: FEWS NET Water Requirement Satisfaction Index, Cropland and Rangeland (Kenya)
datasets.gaps: Only the rangeland-MAM series (FEWS e2, end-of-season dekad 21) extends to 2026; the other three series reach 2026 once their end-of-season dekad (33/36) is published, typically late November to January.

datasets.title: Unified exposure tables by admin unit
datasets.description: Crop, livestock and human-population exposure summed to admin 0/1/2. The denominator behind every hazard-exposure percentage.
datasets.gaps: Chosen as the cross-host equivalence proof for issue #29 because every input is pull-from-origin.

datasets.title: FAOSTAT bulk tables
datasets.description: Deflators, producer prices, production, value of production and trade, Africa and world aggregates. Underpins every value-of-production calculation.
datasets.gaps: ROLLING RELEASE, NO VERSION PIN. FAOSTAT rewrites these URLs in place, so two hosts that ran setup months apart hold different data with no way to tell from the filename. This is a live reproducibility risk for value-of-production outputs.

datasets.title: NDMA / FEWS NET market price series
datasets.description: Kenyan market price monitoring cited in the KE-ENSO narrative.
datasets.gaps: Referenced by Atlas outputs but not inventoried, versioned or archived by this project - if the source moves, the citation breaks.

datasets.title: GGCMI Phase 3 crop calendars
datasets.description: Planting and maturity dates per crop, used to build the jagermeyr crop-calendar timeframe.
datasets.gaps: Setup gates the download on a bare file count of 40, not on a manifest.

datasets.title: Global Livestock Production Systems (GLPS)
datasets.description: Livestock production system classification used to split livestock exposure by system.

datasets.title: GLW4 gridded livestock densities (2015 vintage)
datasets.description: Earlier GLW4 vintage, downloaded from Harvard Dataverse by 0_server_setup.R section 3.4.
datasets.gaps: Superseded by GLW4-2020 for exposure work but still downloaded on every fresh setup.

datasets.title: GLW4 gridded livestock densities (2020 vintage)
datasets.description: Gridded Livestock of the World v4, 2020 reference year, 10 km. FAO GLW4 dysymmetric DENSITY rasters (animals per km2), the input to livestock numbers and value of production.
gaps: Confirm on-disk filenames on a host that already holds these files. list.files(glw_dir, '.tif$') globs the whole directory, so a second copy under different names would be stacked alongside the first and silently double the species set. Evidence the products match: a fresh fetch reproduces a cattle density global sum of 2.0384e7, the exact value documented for the CGlabs copy at R/0.4.1_create_livestock_exposure.R:101.
These are per-km2 DENSITY, not per-pixel counts; 0.4.1 multiplies by cellSize to convert. The 2015 vintage was already per-pixel. Do not mix them.

datasets.title: HadISST Dipole Mode Index (DMI)
datasets.description: Indian Ocean Dipole index derived from HadISST, used alongside ENSO phase.
datasets.gaps: Referenced by Atlas outputs but not inventoried, versioned or archived by this project - if the source moves, the citation breaks.

datasets.title: HarvestStat Africa subnational crop statistics
datasets.description: Subnational harvested area and production statistics, cited as a comparator for MapSPAM-derived exposure.
datasets.gaps: Referenced by Atlas outputs but not inventoried, versioned or archived by this project - if the source moves, the citation breaks.

datasets.title: Hazard x exposure (published)
datasets.description: The canonical hazard-exposure product: hazard frequency crossed with crop, livestock and population exposure, by admin unit, scenario, model and severity. The largest single file the Atlas notebooks read.
datasets.gaps: No CDH record yet, despite being the flagship published product.

datasets.title: WMO hydrological basin boundaries (GRDC)
datasets.description: WMO basin polygons used for basin-level summaries of the ISIMIP water variables.

datasets.title: Kenya admin boundaries (COD-AB / IEBC)

datasets.citation_title: Kenya Administrative Boundaries, Counties and Sub-counties (IEBC COD-AB)

datasets.title: Kenya health and education facilities (HOT OSM)
datasets.description: Health facility and school point layers from the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team exports for Kenya.

datasets.title: Kenya flood exposure intersections

datasets.title: Kenya observed flood extent (Copernicus GFM)
datasets.description: Observed Sentinel-1 flood extent from the Copernicus Global Flood Monitoring service, aggregated to monthly and seasonal layers. The OBSERVED counterpart to the modelled JRC return-period hazard.
datasets.citation_title: Kenya Observed Flood Extent (Copernicus GFM, Sentinel-1)
datasets.gaps: Seasonal NDJ and DJF windows stop at 2024; edge windows that cannot be covered in full are absent by design.

datasets.title: Kenya population (GRID3 / WOPR v2.0)
datasets.description: GRID3 population estimates for Kenya from the WorldPop WOPR release, an alternative population denominator to WorldPop constrained.

datasets.title: Kenya 2019 census population (KNBS)
datasets.description: Population by county and sub-county from the 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census.
datasets.citation_title: KNBS 2019 Census Population Counts by County and Sub-county (Kenya)
gaps: KNBS publishes no open licence, so redistribution terms are unresolved.
Cannot be joined at admin 2 - only 183 of 290 sub-counties match the Atlas boundary set.

datasets.title: Kenya population projections (KNBS)
datasets.description: County population projections from KNBS Volume XVI, used to grow census counts to the analysis year.
datasets.citation_title: KNBS Official Population Projections by County, 2020-2045 (Kenya)
gaps: Source is a PDF with two known transcription defects.
County-growth and county-level projection methods differ by roughly 1.4 M people.

datasets.title: Kenya population (WorldPop 2020, constrained 100 m)

datasets.title: Kenya electricity network (KPLC)

datasets.title: Monthly hazard indices (NEX-GDDP-CMIP6)

Wall-clock cost of regeneration on PASCAL is unmeasured - size it on one GCM before committing to a full rebuild.
